Suspected small background notch at lower neck/far shoulder on left and horizontal wrist/hand discontinuity on defeated right require source/fragment comparison before disposition. Defeated figure remains visible in a lower standing crouch, not disappearance; no collapse claim. Blue/gold angular shards in dodge and reaction are attack FX.

name: Lemur

name: Boa

At idle90 left tail also reaches/cuts the left edge. This is a full-figure clipping HOLD despite native mechanics PASS; the cutoff is inside the1024x576 image, not its physical bottom edge. Earlier reaction bodies remain continuous; saddle blotches/red tail/dark eye stripe preserved. Blue/gold dodge shards are FX.
comparison: Read-only source trace: battle2/stage.ts draws the near plate above actors; parts-rig.ts measures upward rise for framing. Near-plate over-occlusion is a plausible contributor to the internal horizontal cutoff; no renderer/motion code edited and no conclusive root-cause claim.
